request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:CANDY:LAND_BARON

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one small free-standing map piece for one square tile of a strategy map: big simple chunky shapes, calmer and less saturated than units, no face, no people, outlined in a darker tone of each colour, never pure black. Nothing is drawn under or around it except what the subject names: no ground plate, no grass, no isometric block.
layers.negative: ground plate, platform, grass square, isometric block, background, people

layers.text: Subject: the Candy Land Baron's monument: one stout square boundary block of milk chocolate, a little wider at its foot, with a carved shield bearing a small cupcake on its front, one big golden caramel crown resting on its flat top and a small wafer signpost with two blank arrow boards beside it. Milk chocolate (#7a4526) shaded darker on its right side, vanilla cream, golden caramel (#e0a040), pale pink (#f6c9d2, never red); rose-brown outline; taller than it is wide. Monument only.
Small signpost; nothing touches the edges.
